title: Reorder List
prompt: You are given the head of a singly linked-list. The list can be represented as: L0 → L1 → … → Ln - 1 → Ln. Reorder the list to be on the following form: L0 → Ln → L1 → Ln - 1 → L2 → Ln - 2 → …
hints: Find the middle of the list (slow/fast pointers). Split into two halves.
Reverse the second half. Then merge: take one from first half, one from reversed second half, alternating.
Finding middle: slow moves 1, fast moves 2. When fast reaches end, slow is at middle.
